verdict.rationale: The only calendar-related evidence is indirect: MCP changelog entries note that external AI apps can 'act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts,' implying Missive holds calendar data, but there is no documentation of an in-app calendar view, RSVP/invite response flow, or event-creation UI comparable to inbox features. Missing for 10: dedicated calendar panel/view docs, invite accept/decline UI, and event creation flow evidence — only an AI-assistant-access mention exists.
